sub_theme: Multiplication and Division Recap (2, 5, 10 Times Tables)

lessons.title: Story Time: A Times Tables Adventure
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to discuss how a character uses maths in a story.
success_criteria: I can say how the character used maths.
I can find a times table fact in the story.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss where children use times tables in real life.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a story where a character solves a problem using multiplication, modelling discussion.
lessons.independent_task: Children discuss and record how maths helped the character.
key_questions: How did maths help the character?
What times table fact did they use?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension of a maths-based narrative — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.plenary: Recap how maths helped in the story.
lessons.home_link: Think of a time you used maths to solve a problem.

lessons.title: 2 Times Table Recall
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recall the 2 times table fluently.
success_criteria: I can recall 2 times table facts.
I can recall them in a different order.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model recalling 2 times table facts fluently, in and out of order.
lessons.independent_task: Children practise recalling 2 times table facts, including out of order.
key_questions: What is 7 x 2?
What is 2 x 9?

differentiation.support: Recall facts in order with support
differentiation.greater_depth: Recall facts fluently in any order

lessons.assessment_notes: Consolidation check on 2 times table fluency, an end-of-year expectation — evidence for MATHS.N3.

lessons.title: Writing Times Table Rhymes
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to write a simple rhyme to help remember a times table fact.
success_criteria: I can write a times table fact.
I can make it rhyme or rhythmic.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap simple rhymes/rhythms used to remember facts.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model writing a simple rhyme or rhythmic phrase to remember a times table fact.
lessons.independent_task: Children write their own times table rhyme or rhythmic phrase.
key_questions: What times table fact will you use?
How can you make it memorable?

differentiation.greater_depth: Write an original rhyme for multiple facts

lessons.assessment_notes: Note creative writing applied to a memory technique for maths — evidence for ENG.W2.
lessons.plenary: Share times table rhymes with the class.
lessons.home_link: Teach your times table rhyme to your family.

lessons.title: 5 Times Table Recall
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recall the 5 times table fluently.
success_criteria: I can recall 5 times table facts.
I can recall them in a different order.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model recalling 5 times table facts fluently, in and out of order.
lessons.independent_task: Children practise recalling 5 times table facts, including out of order.
key_questions: What is 6 x 5?
What is 5 x 8?

differentiation.support: Recall facts in order with support
differentiation.greater_depth: Recall facts fluently in any order

lessons.assessment_notes: Consolidation check on 5 times table fluency — evidence for MATHS.N3.

lessons.title: Phonics: Reading Maths Words
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read maths-themed words.
success_criteria: I can read maths words.
I can read a sentence about maths.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Reinforce a spelling pattern, applying it to maths-themed words (e.g. 'times', 'divide', 'equal').
lessons.independent_task: Children read themed word and sentence cards.
key_questions: Can you read this word?
Can you read this sentence?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note phonics/spelling application — evidence for ENG.R1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate reading progress with a themed reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading maths words over the week.

lessons.title: 10 Times Table Recall
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recall the 10 times table fluently.
success_criteria: I can recall 10 times table facts.
I can recall them in a different order.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model recalling 10 times table facts fluently, in and out of order.
lessons.independent_task: Children practise recalling 10 times table facts, including out of order.
key_questions: What is 4 x 10?
What is 10 x 9?

differentiation.support: Recall facts in order with support
differentiation.greater_depth: Recall facts fluently in any order

lessons.assessment_notes: Consolidation check on 10 times table fluency — evidence for MATHS.N3.

lessons.title: Times Tables Quiz Show
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer and ask times table questions in a quiz format.
success_criteria: I can answer a times table question.
I can ask a times table question.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all three times tables studied this week.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss how to ask a clear times table question.
lessons.independent_task: Children play a times tables quiz game in teams, asking and answering questions.
resources_needed: Times table fact cards for quiz questions
key_questions: What is this times table fact?
Can you ask us a question?

differentiation.greater_depth: Create and ask original quiz questions including division facts

lessons.assessment_notes: Note cumulative times table knowledge and questioning skill — evidence for ENG.SL1/MATHS.N3.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family on the 2, 5 and 10 times tables.

lessons.title: Division Facts for 2, 5 and 10
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recall division facts related to the 2, 5 and 10 times tables.
success_criteria: I can recall a division fact.
I can link it to a times table fact.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the relationship between multiplication and division.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model recalling division facts related to 2, 5 and 10 times tables (e.g. 20 ÷ 5 = 4 relates to 4 x 5 = 20).
lessons.independent_task: Children practise recalling division facts for 2, 5 and 10, linking to times table facts.
key_questions: What is 30 ÷ 5?
What times table fact does this relate to?

differentiation.support: Use times table grids for support
differentiation.greater_depth: Recall division facts fluently without support

lessons.assessment_notes: Record division fact recall, completing the times tables recap — evidence for MATHS.N3.
lessons.home_link: Practise division facts for 2, 5 and 10 together.

lessons.title: Times Tables Adventure Quiz
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer comprehension questions about a maths-themed story.
success_criteria: I can answer a retrieval question.
I can answer an inference question.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's maths-themed story from Monday.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a summary passage, modelling retrieval and inference questions.
lessons.independent_task: Children answer a mix of retrieval and inference questions about the passage.
key_questions: How did the character solve the problem?
Why was maths useful here?

differentiation.support: Answer retrieval questions with text pointing

lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension progress — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family using a times tables story idea.

lessons.title: Times Tables Topic Recap and Celebration
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate fluent recall of the 2, 5 and 10 times tables and related division facts.
success_criteria: I can recall 2, 5 and 10 times table facts fluently.
I can recall related division facts.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all times tables and division facts learned this week.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Quick recap quiz format covering all three times tables and related division facts.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a final times tables and division consolidation activity.
key_questions: What have you got quicker at this week?
Which facts are you most confident with?

differentiation.support: Word bank and grid support provided

lessons.assessment_notes: End of times tables recap unit consolidation summary for each child — evidence for MATHS.N3.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate the week's times tables fluency progress.
lessons.home_link: Keep practising times tables regularly with your family.
